title: Otter in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#D2A679'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#9B6B47'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='32' r='6' fill='#7A4F30'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='32' r='6' fill='#7A4F30'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='32' r='3' fill='#C98B5E'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='32' r='3' fill='#C98B5E'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#F2DCC4'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2A1B10'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2A1B10'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='39' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3A2418'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 52 Q50 56 55 52' stroke='#5A3A24' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M28 56 Q50 64 72 56 L72 62 Q50 70 28 62 Z' fill='#E63946'/>
  <path d='M62 60 L66 80 L60 82 L57 62 Z' fill='#C1121F'/>
  <!-- scarf fringe -->
  <line x1='60' y1='82' x2='59' y2='86' stroke='#E63946' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='82' x2='62' y2='86' stroke='#E63946' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='81' x2='65' y2='85' stroke='#E63946' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='68' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#A97950'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='68' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#A97950'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='36' y1='49' x2='26' y2='47' stroke='#E8D5C0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='52' x2='26' y2='53' stroke='#E8D5C0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='49' x2='74' y2='47' stroke='#E8D5C0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='52' x2='74' y2='53' stroke='#E8D5C0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M26 82 Q12 88 8 80 Q6 74 14 76' fill='#7A4F30'/>
</svg>
